aside: ShroudForge owns startup asset patching and runs EML packages in its mods folder

mods.reason: runs under ShroudForge (hosted by Kiln): its ShroudForge switch is on (Kiln's copy at S:\steamapps\common\Enshrouded\mods\fcu-render-observer)

ShroudForge (hosted by Kiln) runs this start, but ShroudForge has Kiln's copy at S:\steamapps\common\Enshrouded\mods\more-gliders switched off: it has no extended.mod.json, the file that holds ShroudForge's switch (ShroudForge keeps a package off until its switch is on). Nothing applies it this start. Press Play in the Kiln launcher (or activate the profile again): Kiln switches it on in ShroudForge's settings
ShroudForge runs it on the other side only: its extended.mod.json targets the server only (Kiln's copy at S:\steamapps\common\Enshrouded\mods\server-only-tweak)
